items.author: tedin7
items.title: shader: lower 64-bit scalar bit-count and scan ops in gfx2hlsl (Part of #1723)
items.note:
Part of #1723

What this unblocks: shaders that count or scan bits in scalar registers (s_bcnt0/1, s_ff0/ff1 and s_flbit on 64-bit pairs) now translate in gfx2hlsl instead of stopping at `Unsupported`.

Adds s_bcnt0_i32_b32/b64, s_bcnt1_i32_b32/b64, s_ff0_i32_b64, s_ff1_i32_b64, s_flbit_i32_b64 and s_flbit_i32_i64 to `tools/startup/gfx2hlsl.py`. The 32-bit s_ff0/s_ff1/s_flbit forms are left to the open PRs that already carry them. The counts set SCC to result != 0; the scans return -1 for no match and leave SCC alone. A 64-bit source must be a register pair up to s105; inline constants, exec/vcc/m0, lane-mask data and modifiers are refused.
